tools.name: catalogue_search
tools.description: Find applications in the TUR application catalogue by name or alias. Returns the identifier, name, category and publisher of each match. Nothing is installed or started.

query.description: The name of an application, or part of it.

tools.name: catalogue_show
tools.description: Show the catalogue entry of one application, by the identifier that catalogue_search returned: what it is, who publishes it, and the ways it can be run on TUR with their ratings.

id.description: An application identifier from catalogue_search, such as com.discord.discord.

tools.name: catalogue_route
tools.description: Work out how one application can be run on this computer: the recommended route (native, Flatpak, Wine, Android, a Windows guest or the web), the other routes in order, and what would have to be installed or enabled first. Nothing is installed or started.

id.description: An application identifier from catalogue_search, such as com.discord.discord.
